identifier.value: MindFi Employee Assistance and Wellbeing Platform

product.name: MindFi Employee Assistance and Wellbeing Platform
product.description: A digital platform providing employee mental health support through on-demand therapy, self-care resources, and real-time analytics for employers.

product.name: On-Demand Therapy and Coaching
product.description: A service enabling employees to schedule therapy or coaching sessions with certified professionals within 24 hours via a digital platform.

product.name: Self-Care Resources
product.description: A collection of digital self-care tools including webinars, audio exercises, self-assessments, and online communities to support employee mental wellbeing.

product.name: Real-Time Analytics and Insights Dashboard
product.description: An analytics dashboard providing employers with real-time data on employee program utilization and wellbeing impact, including AI-generated insights for proactive management.

product.name: Employer Platform
product.description: A web-based platform for employers to launch, manage, and monitor their employee wellbeing programs with automation and integrated analytics.

product.name: Emergency Wellbeing Support
product.description: A service offering urgent mental health support and crisis management with rapid access to professional care and 24/7 communication channels.
